info.title: Nirmata agent API
info.description: What an AI agent calls to import a world and to adapt it. The agent never reaches the database. Make a token in the World tab (Agent access); it is shown once, belongs to one world and one author, and expires. Operations list the scopes that admit them under `x-scopes-any-of`: `import.*` for importing, `adaptation.*` for adapting; a token made in the panel carries all four. This file is kept in step with the routes by a test (apps/server/test/agent-openapi.test.ts). Token management (`/api/worlds/{name}/agent-tokens`) is for the signed-in author, not the agent, and is not listed. A token may be a lane: it names the kinds of card it may write (for example only character, or only clothes, adornment and object), carries the import scopes only, and the server answers 403 to a card of another kind and to anything that is not a card (skills, rules, publishing, the story). A lane token reads everything.

fields.description: Named parts, lowercase with hyphens. `secrets` is host-only. Blank parts are dropped.

owner.description: The character a clothes or adornment belongs to.

slides.description: A compiled slide deck; see VnSlideDeckSchema in packages/core.

VnParts.description: At least one of the three.

E400.description: The request is not valid; the message says what to change.

E401.description: The token is missing, wrong, expired or revoked.

E403.description: The token lacks the scope, is for another world, or the author may not do that.

put.summary: Save a card, making it if it is new
put.description: The id is `kind.name`. The kind is lowercase letters and digits and may be any name the world uses; the six standard kinds are lore, character, place, arc, rule, scene. Answers 201 when the card is new, 200 when it replaced one. A field named `secrets` is host-only. A lane token may write only the kinds it names.

delete.description: A card that was published keeps its history and only leaves the draft. A lane token may write only the kinds it names.
